name: Signal Loss
Description: Loss of contact or connection quality on the radio frequency links (control, telemetry, or video) due to range limits, physical obstructions, or RF attenuation.
Symptoms: Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) dropping below threshold levels
Complete cessation of incoming telemetry or control updates
Video transmission noise, freeze, or black screen
Impact: Loss of situational awareness and remote pilot control capability. Risks collision if the drone continues on its path without operator feedback.
Recommended Action: Trigger the autonomous Return-To-Home (RTH) protocol. Climb to a pre-defined safe altitude to clear obstacles and attempt to re-establish line-of-sight. Broadcast locator beacons.
